prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production transparent PNG icon sprite atlas for Calibra Pencil, a real installable desktop icon theme. The attached bell sketch is a STYLE REFERENCE, not an edit target. Create new hand-drawn GRAPHITE PENCIL objects with exactly that informal soft pencil drawing quality: slightly irregular repeated searching contours, visible grainy pencil pressure, fine diagonal cross-hatching and soft graphite shading, simple rounded forms with a hint of three-dimensional volume. Monochrome warm graphite gray only. NOT smooth vector outlines, NOT colored pencil, NOT clay, NOT black filled silhouettes. Square image, EXACTLY SIX COLUMNS and SIX ROWS, 36 standalone icons with perfectly regular row-major centers. Maintain generous even spacing: the full drawing fits inside the central 72% of its cell; leave empty gutters, and keep all strokes and any shading away from cell borders. NO printed captions, NO labels, NO grid lines, NO watermark. All background pixels must be genuinely TRANSPARENT. Do NOT copy the paper square, border, paper texture or backdrop of the reference; only the drawn strokes and their subtle pencil shading remain. No white blocks filling objects: keep light internal shading transparent. Practical app icon silhouettes readable at 32px. New subjects in strict row-major order:
Row 1: a closed book with a plus badge (add books); document with pencil (metadata); two curved arrows making a circle (convert); open book (read); paper airplane (send); floppy disk (save).
Row 2: folded newspaper (news); three connected round nodes (share); waste bin (remove); three adjustment sliders (preferences); open book with pencil (edit); three sparkles (polish).
Row 3: three upright books (library); magnifying glass (search); hang tag (tags); three stacked layers (series); spiral notebook with tabs (catalog); shopping bag (store).
Row 4: human head and shoulders (author); jigsaw puzzle piece (plugins); blank page with a folded corner (file); folder; e-reader tablet; desktop monitor.
Row 5: heart; five-point star; calendar; envelope; globe; printer.
Row 6: downward arrow into a tray (download); upward arrow from a tray (upload); open cardboard box (unpack); two chain links; sticky note; cloud with a downward arrow (metadata download).
The objects should look carefully sketched with a real pencil, like the attached bell. Preserve clean generous transparent separation between icons.
